chapter: Honors, Gibson and Dorsey late years
title: Gibson parties move to Vail and the Broadmoor Hotel
summary: The parties moved to Vail, back to Aspen, and then to the Broadmoor in Colorado Springs, growing to hundreds of guests and 67 musicians.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: But we don't have time on these tapes to go through all the personnel. The fourth year or so, he decided for a change of scenery, and the guest list was growing larger and larger, and in fact, the parties were, as I say, the guest list was larger, and the party gained prominence around the country by heresay, and everybody was clam pring to get on that guest list, and Dick had to screen whoever he wanted, and he was allowing the real jazz bands that could afford to make the trip and come out, he was adding them to his list. And as a change of pace and scenery, he decided to get out of them and developed -- it had just been accepted as a corporation, was Vail, Colorado. Now that was undeveloped then. In the middle sixties. And of course now, it is a reknown place. I think former President Ford has fallen down on the slopes a few times there.
Anyway, we had two years there, and the guest list kept growing, and the bands kept getting larger and larger.

Then he decided to go back to Aspen for a couple of years, and he employed two or three places to present the music as the list of band musicians were growing larger, and he would have one session in the afternoon at the Jerome Hotel, and then up the street there was a nightclub, and he would employ that because it could seat enough people.

Then eventually, after six or seven years, he tried the Broadmore Hotel, we went down there in Colorado Springs - and I do believe that hotel accomodated the guest list fine, it had a big, enormous dining room. Of course the hotel is one of the world's most famous -- still is -- and we had the last few years, oh, I should say eight approximately, and I don't want to stop and research that, but 8 or 9 years we had been at the Broadmore Hotel in Colorado Springs.

And to give you an idea of how this whole thing snowballed, I believe we had between 7 to a thousand people on the guest list last year, and he had 67 musicians, performing musicians on his guest musical list.
